formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ l : ℕ, ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.Search.QLine (Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l)), PEqualNP.Search.IsResLinQSynRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) π → p.eval (2 ^ l) < PEqualNP.Search.resLinQSize π
plain_statement: For every polynomial p there is l such that every refutation of bit PHP (2^l+1 pigeons, 2^l holes) in R(lin) over the integers with syntactic rules (Defs/SearchQSyn.lean: axioms, Boolean axioms, resolution on first equations, weakening by adding equations, simplification of 0 = c) has size above p(2^l). Restates L-alg-004, refuted because its semantic weakening makes the pigeonhole principle a one-step line. Open (Question 1 of Garg, Goos, Kamath and Sokolov, STOC 2018). Parked: no route.
title: HARD LINK (restated): bit PHP needs superpolynomial dag-like R(lin) refutations over the integers with SYNTACTIC rules
